remarks: Welcome to Fountain Terrace, a well maintained 24-hour gated high-rise in the heart of Stamford offering comfort, convenience, and move-in-ready lifestyle. Step inside this fresh and bright 2-bedroom, 1-bath condo where you are immediately greeted with stunning tree-lined views. Featuring updated kitchen with stainless appliances, a seamless layout with natural light and thoughtful updates make it perfect for first-time buyers, downsizers, or savvy investors. Enjoy peaceful sunrises and nature's beauty in every season-from spring blooms to summer greens, autumn golds, and magical winter snow falls all from your private balcony. Pet-friendly community offers fantastic amenities including a pool, clubhouse, fitness center, and coin-operated laundry facilities-all professionally managed for your ease. Located just minutes from downtown Stamford's shopping, dining, parks, entertainment and public transportation. Ideal for commuters and in-town residents alike. Quick access to Metro-North, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway makes getting around effortless.
